title: Chemainus Theatre

services.name: Tickets
services.desc: The Chemainus Theatre Society is a not-for-profit organization that relies on the financial generosity of individuals and businesses. In turn, we are happy to support the fundraising efforts of other community and non-profit organizations through ticket donations. The Chemainus Theatre is pleased to provide tickets to organizations that work with individuals who face barriers to attending live theatre. These barriers can include financial, social, cultural, and/or physical. This program is made available by our Access Sponsor, BMO, and through the generous support of individuals and businesses that support our Golden Neighbour Program. services.name: Playbill Dining Room Rentals
services.desc: Let us welcome you to the Playbill Dining Room with some great food, the usual warm hospitality, and live piano entertainment. Our Executive Chef has prepared an impressive menu with fresh seasonal salads, delicious starters, choice of entrées and some delectable desserts! Our ever-so-popular buffet options include dinner, lunch and brunch - available on select days. Complement this array of culinary delights with a beverage from our specialty menu of wines, beers, and estate ciders. Dining can be added to your theatre ticket order online or by calling the Box Office. Package discounts available when you purchase both theatre & dining. services.name: Theatre Rentals
services.desc: Welcome to the Chemainus Theatre Festival! We are a vibrant, established and fully professional theatre nestled in the seaside community of Chemainus, BC. We feature some of the finest performers and performances in Canada. The Chemainus Theatre Festival is your place to get together and liven up. As a non-profit society, we exist to serve Vancouver Island and its visitors by creating exceptional theatre that explores and nourishes truth, hope, redemption, love and the human spirit. Chemainus is a picturesque artisan village nestled between the mountains and ocean directly on the Cowichan coast.
